SQL01.sql: SELECT sample_type,COUNT(*) FROM fiber.v_sample_overview GROUP BY sample_type ORDER BY sample_type

SQL02.sql: SELECT beating_revolutions,fiber_length_weighted_mm,tensile_index FROM fiber.v_beating_analysis WHERE material_code='SW' AND beating_revolutions IN (4000,6000,8000) ORDER BY beating_revolutions

SQL03.sql: SELECT canonical_code,tensile_index FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis WHERE tensile_index IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tensile_index DESC,canonical_code LIMIT 3

SQL04.sql: SELECT sample_type,AVG(tensile_index),COUNT(tensile_index),COUNT(*) FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis GROUP BY sample_type ORDER BY sample_type

SQL05.sql: SELECT canonical_code,sw_proportion_pct,hw_proportion_pct,sw_beating_revolutions,hw_beating_revolutions,tensile_index FROM fiber.v_blend_analysis WHERE sw_proportion_pct=10 AND hw_proportion_pct=90

SQL06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fiber.v_blend_analysis WHERE sw_proportion_pct>0 AND hw_proportion_pct>0

SQL07.sql: SELECT f.canonical_code,f.tensile_index,l.file_name,l.sheet_name,l.source_row FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis f JOIN fiber.v_data_lineage l ON f.paper_source_id=l.source_id WHERE f.canonical_code='BLEND_SW010_HW090' AND l.usage_type='paper_measurement'

SQL08.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.sample_id) FROM fiber.v_sample_overview s JOIN fiber.v_data_lineage l ON s.sample_id=l.sample_id

SQL09.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis WHERE tensile_index>(SELECT AVG(tensile_index) FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis)

SQL11.sql: SELECT tensile_index FROM fiber.v_beating_analysis WHERE material_code='SW' AND beating_revolutions=12345

SQL12.sql: SELECT AVG(tensile_index) FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis WHERE canonical_code='NO_SUCH_SAMPLE'

SQL15.sql: SELECT air_permeability,folding_endurance_raw FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis WHERE canonical_code='BLEND_SW010_HW090'

SQL17.sql: SELECT fiber_length_weighted_mm FROM fiber.v_fiber_paper_analysis WHERE canonical_code='BLEND_SW010_HW090'

SQL18.sql: SELECT beating_revolutions,tensile_index FROM fiber.v_beating_analysis WHERE material_code='SW' AND beating_revolutions IN (4000,8000) ORDER BY beating_revolutions
